description: This file defines a custom exception class DepositAccountInterestRateChartNotFoundException used in the savings module of the Fineract project to signal that a specific deposit interest rate chart was not found, based on an identifier.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartNotFoundException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that a deposit account interest rate chart with a specified ID does not exist.

methods.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the ID is invalid.

methods.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message and wraps an underlying EmptyResultDataAccessException.
